Il tuo profilo - Formazione: Formazione EFZ; preferibilmente nell'industria elettrica, del riscaldamento, della macchina o dell'automobile, NIV 15 Completamento del vantaggio - Personalità e metodi di lavoro: affidabile, indipendente, orientata al servizio, resiliente e flessibile - L'esperienza nel settore è auspicabile ma "una mentalità positiva, grande apprendimento e interesse nella materia" è molto più importante per noi - Lingue: conoscenza stilistica del tedesco Contattaci Si può aspettare un'attività responsabile e varia in un'azienda moderna caratterizzata da apprezzamento e rispetto. Che cosa offriamo - Incorporazione individuale e ulteriori possibilità di sviluppo - Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo, open-minded e value-adding - Veicolo aziendale con uso privato in Svizzera - Pacchetti - Compensazioni part-time - Vantaggi sociali interessanti - 5 settimane Vacanze Più Vantaggi possono essere trovati qui: i nostri Vantaggi Contattare Risorse Umane Dajana Levarda, HR Business Partner E-Mail: dajana.levarda@bosch.com Hai bisogno di supporto tecnico? Attendiamo con ansia la vostra richiesta.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Your tasks - You take care of the professional commissioning and repair work of heat pumps and Comfort-Clima. - You take the careful maintenance of these devices according to the high Buderus quality standards. - You analyze and eliminate disturbances – professional, rapid and self-responsive. - You advise customers on the ideal settings of the devices according to personal customer needs. - You inform plant owners about the comprehensive benefits of the Buderus maintenance contracts. - You make standby service (Pikett) in consultation with the team. 
• Your profile - Training: EFZ training; preferably in the electrical, heating, machine or car industry, NIV 15 Completion of advantage - Personality and working methods: reliable, independent, service-oriented, resilient and flexible - Experience in the industry is desirable but "a positive mindset, great learning and interest in matter" is much more important to us - Languages: stylistic knowledge of German Contact us You can look forward to a responsible and varied activity in a modern company that is characterised by appreciation and respect. If you like to work independently, face new challenges and expand your expertise, then you are right with us. We look forward to your application! 
• What we offer - Individual incorporation and further development possibilities - Collaborative, open-minded and value-adding working environment - Company vehicle with private use within Switzerland - Package fees - Part-time compensation - Attractive social benefits - 5 weeks Holiday More Benefits can be found here: our Benefits Contact Human Resources Dajana Levarda, HR Business Partner E-Mail: dajana.levarda@bosch.com Do you need technical support? We look forward to your inquiry.

##

• Your profile - Ausbildung: EFZ-Ausbildung; vorzugsweise in der Elektro-, Heizungs-, Maschinen- oder Autobranche, NIV 15 Abschluss von Vorteil - Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: zuverlässig, eigenverantwortlich, serviceorientiert, belastbar und flexibel - Erfahrung: Erfahrung in der Branche ist wünschenswert aber «ein positives Mindset, grosse Lernbereitschaft und Interesse an der Materie» ist uns viel wichtiger - Sprachen: stilsichere Deutschkenntnisse ## Contact & additional information Du kannst dich auf eine verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem modernen Unternehmen freuen, das von Wertschätzung und Respekt geprägt ist. • Was wir bieten - Individuelle Einarbeitung und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten - Kollegiales, aufgeschlossenes und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld - Firmenfahrzeug mit Privatnutzung innerhalb der Schweiz - Pauschalspesen - Teilzeitpensum - Attraktive Sozialleistungen - 5 Wochen Ferien Weitere Benefits findest du hier: unsere Benefits Kontakt Human Resources Dajana Levarda, HR Business Partner E-Mail: dajana.levarda@bosch.com Kontakt Fachabteilung Raffael Tanner, Leiter technischer Kundendienst E-Mail: raffael.tanner@buderus.ch ## Do you need technical support?
